Both describe the Cdo1-driven cysteine/taurine catabolism axis coupled to Rgn-marked hepatocyte aging, sharing Cdo1, Rgn, Sord, Alad genes and the G6pc regulator, with R3 adding an explicit Car5a/urea-cycle refinement already implied in L3's summary.
